product.ta-22b.summary: The TA 22 B put a second diskette drive in the cassette drive bay.
product.ta-22b.history: It was the twin-drive version of the TA 22 office terminal. Triumph-Adler’s documentation distinguishes it with the letter B.
product.ta-22b.technical.configuration: The two drives let operators use two diskettes at the same workstation. The technical description assigns 16 KiB of RAM and a BAB 06 board to the TA 22 B.
product.ta-22b.technical.verified: BluMach has no runnable profile for this model.
product.ta-22b.technical.limitations: Firmware from an identified unit and program media are still needed to check operation.
